info.title: SyncSpace API
info.description:
Real-time collaborative workspace platform API.

Provides authentication, workspaces, rooms, tasks, files, meetings, whiteboards, chat, code editing, and real-time collaboration via Socket.IO.

post.description: Step 1 of registration: collects name and email, creates a pending user, sends a verification email. If the email already exists but is unverified, refreshes the verification token.

get.description: Validates the verification link token (does NOT consume it). Returns the user's name and email for the password setup page.

post.description: Final registration step: sets the password, marks email verified, and clears the verification token. Does NOT auto-login.

password.description: Password (min 8 chars, must contain uppercase, lowercase, and number)

post.description: Resends a fresh verification email for unverified accounts.

400.description: Email already verified or not found

post.description: Validates credentials, issues access + refresh token pair. Rejects unverified accounts with 403.
Creates or uses a demo account (demo@syncspace.dev / demo123) and issues tokens.
Reads refresh token from cookie, validates, rotates (deletes old, creates new), and issues a new access token.
Deletes the refresh token from DB and clears the cookie.
Generates a password reset token, stores hashed version in DB, and sends a reset email. In dev, returns the raw token.
Validates the reset token, sets the new password, and deletes ALL refresh tokens for the user (force re-login everywhere).

password.description: New password (min 8 chars, must contain uppercase, lowercase, and number)

delete.description: Deletes user's Member records, removes from Workspace member lists, deletes the user, and clears refresh token cookie.

put.description: Validates current password, then sets a new one.

newPassword.description: Must contain uppercase, lowercase, and number

get.description: Calculates gamification score based on workspaces, rooms, files, meetings, invites, and tasks. Returns level, badges, and breakdown.

Returns soft-deleted workspaces that can be restored.

post.description: Upload a file via multipart/form-data. Max 50MB. Executables are blocked.
Uploads and sets user avatar image.

Lists meetings where user is host or participant, with optional workspace filter.

put.description: Updates meeting fields (host-only). Auto-sets endedAt on completion.

delete.description: Deletes all notifications for the current user.

get.summary: Get chat messages for a room
get.description: Fetches messages with cursor-based pagination. Max 100 per request. Returns in chronological order.

parameters.name: before

get.description: Lists all non-deleted documents in a room, sorted by path.

put.description: Updates content, name, and/or language. Appends to versionTimestamps on content change.

409.description: Path already exists in this room

put.description: Renames a document/folder. If folder, updates all children's paths.

post.description: Executes user-submitted code in a sandboxed temp directory. Supports Java, Python, C, and C++. All executions have a 10-second timeout and 10KB output limit.

get.description: Returns workspaces where the user is a member but NOT the owner.
